name: R Systems International Ltd
title: R Systems International Ltd - 532735 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Revenue up 29.9% YoY to INR 574.8 cr but organic growth was flat QoQ and utilisation fell to 80.5% from ~84% as bench was built for AI; margin gain partly FX-driven.

utilisation.quote: bringing our utilization down to about 80.5%, which was at its peak at about 84%

triggers.label: Utilisation ~84% → 80.5%
triggers.quote: bringing our utilization down to about 80.5%, which was at its peak at about 84%

triggers.label: TTM ACV wins $76.5m → $82.5m
triggers.quote: We had $76.5 million of ACV on a TTM basis last quarter. We are reporting $82.5 million of ACV wins this quarter.

triggers.label: Organic growth flat QoQ
triggers.quote: we have largely remained flat organically

guidance.quote: We have continued to maintain our margins in a very healthy range, as we had guided in the +17% margin, kind of a range.

guidance.value: no forward guidance; confident in organic growth
guidance.quote: while we don't provide any forward guidance and flavors

red_flags.label: Organic growth flat QoQ; reported growth mostly acquisition and FX
red_flags.quote: we have largely remained flat organically

red_flags.label: SG&A dip from AR provision reversal
red_flags.quote: This is mainly due to reversal of conservative AR provision on account of realization in this quarter

red_flags.label: Novigo restated revenue ~$21-22m vs ~$32m at acquisition
red_flags.quote: That restated will stand at about $21-$22 million a year.

evasions.quote: while we don't provide any forward guidance and flavors, but very high confidence
it's not exactly coming from a system, so we are not reporting it yet
